reported_state: Candidate reconciliation separates the source's selected-action quotient (A) from its flat detector tangent (B). The Lean source-convention adapter supplies a finite matrix witness for B, maps the source frame by right multiplication with η into the existing solder Gram carrier, retains the quadratic remainder, and proves both the directional HasFDerivAt along every matrix direction (including the pinned symmetric q path) and the full matrix-variable Fréchet derivative at the flat frame. The latter uses the Frobenius norm on finite Role matrices and has derivative H ↦ Hη + ηHᵀ. The derivative is also transported to the actual finite solder readout in the constant-coframe coordinates H ↦ Hη; this makes no claim about arbitrary sitewise coframe variations. None of these results connects A's selected action quotient to that Lean carrier or closes global connection elimination, physical metric/source selection, or independent C0 acceptance.
